app.title: Wails Translate
app.subtitle: Documentation translation workbench
splash.title: Translate the Wails documentation
splash.body: This workbench helps you translate the Wails documentation into other languages. See what's up to date, what's gone stale, and what's still missing for each locale, then edit by hand or with an LLM, review the changes, and submit a pull request.
onboard.title: How will you translate?
onboard.body: You can translate by hand, or use an LLM to machine-translate and then review. You can change this anytime in LLM configuration.
onboard.keyLater: No key entered — you can add it later in LLM configuration.
